title: Answer: the quantum statistics of transmitter release and the neuroscience of volition

statements.text: What can be checked is whether exocytosis at cortical synapses behaves as a quantum event with probability below one, whether that probability changes with voluntary intention, and whether the neural events of volitional action have sufficient physical causes. Cucu claims to find critical neuronal events still without sufficient physical explanation.

sources.quote: Each incoming nerve impulse causes the emission of transmitter molecules by the process of exocytosis.
claims to find critical neuronal events which do not have sufficient physical explanation even today
